name: axint
description: Compile, validate, repair, and prove Apple-native Swift surfaces from Claude Desktop.
long_description:
Axint turns TypeScript, Python, and compact schema input into validated Swift for Apple-native features. Compile App Intents, SwiftUI views, WidgetKit widgets, and full app scaffolds from Claude Desktop, then use Fix Packets, Cloud Check, and Xcode-facing proof loops to repair and ship ordinary generated Swift.

Includes 36 MCP tools, five built-in prompts, and 26 bundled templates spanning messaging, productivity, health, commerce, media, navigation, smart home, and more.
